supply.def: Supply: the quantities of a good sellers are willing and able to offer at each price, shown as an upward-sloping supply curve. The quantity supplied is the amount offered at one particular price.

law-of-supply.def: The law of supply: other things equal, when a good's price rises the quantity supplied rises, and when it falls the quantity supplied falls.

supply-shifter.def: Determinants of supply: the changes other than the good's own price that shift supply: input prices, technology, the prices of other goods the seller could produce, taxes and subsidies, expectations and the number of sellers.

market-supply.def: Market supply: the sum of every individual seller's quantity supplied at each price (a horizontal sum of the individual supply curves).
